Attribute.Name: Shipping Unit Description
Attribute.ValueTemplate:
<derive expr="{
    shortItemDesc:=value('PMDM.AT.ShortItemDescription'),
    packToChild:=references('product', 'PMDM.PRT.PackToChild'),
    caseToChild:=references('product', 'PMDM.PRT.CaseToChild'),
    palletToChild:=references('product', 'PMDM.PRT.PalletToChild'),
    objectTypeID:=StepObjectTypeID()
}
if(
    or(
        exact(
            objectTypeID,
            'PMDM.PRD.ExternalSourceRecord'
        ),
        exact(
            objectTypeID,
            'PMDM.PRD.InternalSourceRecord'
        )
    ),
    if(
        len(shortItemDesc)>0,
        shortItemDesc,
        stepname()
    ),
    list(
        iterate(
            iterate(
                if(
                    listlen(packToChild)>0,
                    packToChild,
                    if(
                        listlen(caseToChild)>0,
                        caseToChild,
                        if(
                            listlen(palletToChild)>0,
                            palletToChild,
                            ''
                        )
                    )
                ),
                'referencetarget()'
            ),
            'value("PMDM.AT.ShippingUnitDescription")'
        ),
        ', '
    )
)"/>

MetaData.Value: A short description of the product on packaging objects
